newsitem.title: CHINA: Sino-foreign JV gets US$15 mln loan for berth.
newsitem.headline: Sino-foreign JV gets US$15 mln loan for berth.

text.p: A US$15 million term loan facility for Shenzhen Kaifeng Terminal Co Ltd has been completed, arranger Sumitomo Bank said on Wednesday.

The borrower is a Sino-foreign equity joint venture company of Chiwan Wharf Holdings Ltd with 50 percent, Top Glory Holdings Co Ltd with 25 percent and International Enterprises Co Ltd with 25 percent.
The deal is guaranteed by Chiwan Wharf Holdings, Top Glory and Kerry Properties Ltd.
Proceeds will be used to finance the development costs of berth No. 10 at Shenzhen's Chiwan harbour.
The five-year facility pays a margin of 98 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
There is a management fee of 100 basis points and a commitment fee of 12.5 basis points.
Sumitomo Bank's Guangzhou branch, United Overseas Bank's Guangzhou branch, Fuji Bank's Shenzhen branch and Sanwa Bank's Shenzhen branch joined the syndication.
